description: OpenApps tracks listings, rankings, launches, featuring, and MCP toolsets across AI app stores such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and Grok Bot. It provides public catalog and ecosystem data about those stores and the MCP servers linked from their listings.
summary: OpenApps exposes a public read-only REST API at `/v1`, a public Streamable HTTP MCP server at `/mcp`, and an A2A-style JSON-RPC endpoint at `/a2a`; API keys and OAuth 2.0 can optionally raise limits for the REST and MCP surfaces.
